content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

E.J. Carroll, the veteran character and voice-over actor known for his roles in The Deuce, Boardwalk Empire, Blue Bloods and the Law & Order franchise, has died at 66.

Carroll died suddenly on Thursday, November 19, 2026, while on his way to a voice-over recording session, his manager, Jon Mason of Mason-Lewis Entertainment, confirmed to TheWrap. Deadline also reported his death. No cause of death has been determined or released.

Carroll built a decades-long career as a working actor in television, film and voice-over, appearing in prestige cable dramas and long-running network procedurals. He was best known for his roles in HBO’s The Deuce and Boardwalk Empire, along with recurring work across the Law & Order franchise and a role on Blue Bloods.

Sources: TheWrap; Deadline.
